scope: Original user courtyard camera after bend-envelope and joint following-convergence fixes. Other cameras, source histories and the whole city remain outside this pass; the separate wide-view review remains open.

browser.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (0x00002684) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-32.0.16.1656)

method.sampling: Four10s in-browser blocks with requested50ms timer and intervening serialization gaps; actual observed clock range57.497s. Reads actual GPU instance attributes and shader-time yaw, including membership refreshes, stops and smooth turns.
method.carCar: SAT of real4.5m asset length and asset-specific width, centered at actual interpolated shader position and yaw.
method.carPedestrian: Actual vehicle OBB against controller.35m pedestrian disc. Independently tests the conservative oriented AABB containing every baked animation frame of each near-person model, with its real local-center offset.
method.poseBoundsMeaning: A positive all-pose gap proves separation of the body envelopes for every baked pose and their interpolations at each sampled time; it is not a continuous-between-samples proof or an exact triangle-collision solver.
method.queue: Same directed supporting line and overlapping source intervals; center station gap8m, tolerance only numerical roundoff.
method.coverage: Up to64managedcars and64managedpedestrians per sample; all three car models observed. Person sprites lack baked geometry and are excluded from the additional all-pose check, but included in the nominal controller-disc check.

results.pauseFrameCaveat: Initial pause had37 additional asset-driven frames while shader clock, actors and signals stayed exactly unchanged. Final pause had0additionalframes; this does not report a paused-idle pass for the initial unsettled asset interval.
